questions.stem_text: The villagers invited a local _____ to teach children how to make clay pots.
written_answers: artisan
questions.explanation_vi: An artisan makes useful or decorative objects by hand.

questions.stem_text: My grandfather still _____ the traditional method of weaving baskets.
written_answers: passes down
questions.explanation_vi: pass down = transmit skills or knowledge to younger generations.

questions.stem_text: We should _____ these old buildings because they tell stories about our town.
written_answers: preserve
questions.explanation_vi: preserve = protect and keep in good condition.

questions.stem_text: This neighbourhood is famous _____ its colourful weekend market.
written_answers: for
questions.explanation_vi: be famous for + noun.

questions.stem_text: After moving to the city, Mai found it difficult to _____ the noise.
written_answers: deal with
questions.explanation_vi: deal with = handle a problem or situation.

questions.stem_text: There is a lot of _____ on the roads during rush hour.
written_answers: traffic congestion
questions.explanation_vi: Traffic congestion means too many vehicles and slow movement.

questions.stem_text: The new metro line makes it easier for residents to _____ the city.
written_answers: get around
questions.explanation_vi: get around = travel from place to place.

questions.stem_text: Many teenagers feel _____ when they have too much homework and little rest.
written_answers: stressed
questions.explanation_vi: stressed = under mental or emotional pressure.

questions.stem_text: You should _____ your tasks instead of doing everything at the last minute.
written_answers: prioritise
questions.explanation_vi: prioritise = decide which tasks are most important.

questions.stem_text: My parents remind me to maintain a healthy _____ between study and relaxation.
written_answers: balance
questions.explanation_vi: maintain a balance between A and B.

questions.stem_text: I can't decide _____ to ask for advice about the conflict.
written_answers: who
questions.explanation_vi: who to ask identifies the person from whom to seek advice.

questions.stem_text: Could you show me _____ to get to the community centre?
written_answers: how
questions.explanation_vi: how to get to = the way to reach a place.

questions.stem_text: They are discussing _____ to organise a craft fair next month.
written_answers: how
questions.explanation_vi: how to organise = the method of organising.

questions.stem_text: The _____ the streets are, the _____ it is to cross safely.
written_answers: busier / harder
questions.explanation_vi: Double comparatives: The + comparative..., the + comparative....

questions.stem_text: The more time you spend on your phone at night, _____.
options: the less sleep you may get
the more sleepy you are get
written_answers: the less sleep you may get
questions.explanation_vi: The more..., the less... describes a proportional relationship.

questions.stem_text: The more carefully you plan your day, _____.
options: the more efficiently you can work
written_answers: the more efficiently you can work
questions.explanation_vi: Use comparative adverbs: more carefully; more efficiently.

questions.stem_text: If it rains tomorrow, we _____ the outdoor workshop indoors.
written_answers: will move
questions.explanation_vi: First conditional: If + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.stem_text: If I _____ a bicycle, I would ride to school every day.
written_answers: had
questions.explanation_vi: Second conditional: If + past simple, would + base verb.

questions.stem_text: If you want to feel less stressed, you _____ take short breaks during study time.
written_answers: should
questions.explanation_vi: should gives appropriate advice in a real conditional.

questions.stem_text: Lan said she _____ an English club the following week.
written_answers: would join
questions.explanation_vi: Reported future: will join → would join; next week → the following week.

questions.stem_text: The teacher asked Minh _____ he had finished his assignment.
written_answers: if
questions.explanation_vi: Reported yes/no questions use if or whether.

questions.stem_text: She asked me where _____.
written_answers: I had bought my notebook
questions.explanation_vi: Reported questions have statement word order and typically backshift: where I had bought ...

questions.stem_text: Nam: “Could you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?” — Hoa: “_____”
options: It’s next to the post office.
written_answers: It’s next to the post office.
questions.explanation_vi: A helpful reply gives the location requested.

questions.stem_text: Teen: “I feel exhausted after studying for hours.” — Friend: “_____”
options: You should take a short break.
You ought to skip every meal.
written_answers: You should take a short break.
questions.explanation_vi: A short break is sensible health advice.

questions.stem_text: What is the main purpose of Reading A?
options: To persuade all teenagers to leave school.
To explain how a factory produces baskets.
To compare every market in Viet Nam.
To describe a project that connects young people with traditional crafts.
written_answers: To describe a project that connects young people with traditional crafts.
questions.explanation_vi: The passage focuses on workshops and young volunteers supporting local crafts.

questions.stem_text: Before the project, where did artisans mainly sell their baskets?
written_answers: At nearby shops.
questions.explanation_vi: Paragraph 1 states that artisans sold baskets only to nearby shops.

questions.stem_text: Why was the craft street closed to cars during market hours?
options: The market was too far from town.
The artisans wanted more car parking.
Residents had complained about noise and traffic.
A new bridge had been built.
written_answers: Residents had complained about noise and traffic.
questions.explanation_vi: The council responded to complaints about traffic and noise.

questions.stem_text: Which task do teen volunteers NOT do according to the passage?
options: Show visitors where to put rubbish.
Set the prices of products sold at the market.
written_answers: Set the prices of products sold at the market.
questions.explanation_vi: No mention of volunteers setting prices; other three are explicit tasks.

questions.stem_text: In paragraph 2, “They” in “They also help older craftspeople...” refers to _____.
written_answers: teen volunteers
questions.explanation_vi: The preceding sentence names teen volunteers.

questions.stem_text: The word “affordable” in the last paragraph is closest to _____.
written_answers: not too expensive
questions.explanation_vi: Affordable = reasonably priced.

questions.stem_text: What can be inferred about the project?
options: It has completely replaced factory work.
It has ended because visitors dislike crafts.
It forces students to pay for every workshop.
It has achieved some success but still faces financial challenges.
written_answers: It has achieved some success but still faces financial challenges.
questions.explanation_vi: The conclusion mentions increasing interest and a challenge balancing prices and fair pay.

questions.stem_text: Why did Green Hill School start the Healthy Habits Challenge?
options: To make every student study all night.
To help students improve everyday habits that support learning.
written_answers: To help students improve everyday habits that support learning.
questions.explanation_vi: Teachers wanted to explore simple helpful habits for tired students.

questions.stem_text: What did participants record in their diaries?
options: Their bedtime and energy level the following day.
The prices of all their meals.
written_answers: Their bedtime and energy level the following day.
questions.explanation_vi: Paragraph 2 explicitly gives bedtime and next-day energy.

questions.stem_text: Which activity was an example of a habit change?
options: Putting phones away before going to bed.
Studying with a phone until midnight.
written_answers: Putting phones away before going to bed.
questions.explanation_vi: Students put their phones away half an hour before bed.

questions.stem_text: The word “overwhelmed” in the last paragraph is closest to _____.
options: unable to cope with too much pressure
written_answers: unable to cope with too much pressure
questions.explanation_vi: Overwhelmed describes being unable to manage demands or stress.

questions.stem_text: Which statement is NOT true about the programme?
options: Students selected two habits to improve.
Students had to pay for exercise classes.
written_answers: Students had to pay for exercise classes.
questions.explanation_vi: The school did not require special food or paid exercise classes.

questions.stem_text: What happened at the end of the programme?
options: Most students felt better prepared, but not all had better test results.
All students stopped having difficult days.
Teachers told families that results would be immediate.
written_answers: Most students felt better prepared, but not all had better test results.
questions.explanation_vi: The text says most felt more prepared, but not everyone improved test results.

questions.stem_text: Which lesson best matches Reading B?
options: Only the number of study hours affects grades.
Healthy habits work immediately for everyone.
Small healthy changes need time and regular practice.
Teenagers should avoid making daily plans.
written_answers: Small healthy changes need time and regular practice.
questions.explanation_vi: Teachers emphasize gradual progress and regular practice.
